facts.fact: ACSI presented PDRCL to the Mayor of Brazzaville on 30 April 2026 as recording every transaction in real time through field agents' mobile terminals, with a dashboard for the municipal authority; no register of payers is stated.
ACSI made the official presentation of PDRCL to the Mayor of Brazzaville on 30 April 2026, after the February validation.
